create_c10d_store: create a TCPStore for PyTorch distributed training with hostname, port, rank, and world size
parse_query_params: parse a URL query string into a dictionary of key-value pairs from ampersand-separated pairs
register_tcp_retry_handler: register a TCP retry rendezvous handler that retries up to 5 times with exponential backoff
use_complicit_store: use a ComplicitStore wrapper that bypasses barrier-based synchronization by returning world size on add calls
register_barrierless_handler: register a barrierless TCP rendezvous handler that wraps the store with ComplicitStore for barrierless coordination
